patch_list: Accent color

Swaps the red of TikTok's main buttons and red text for blue, green, purple, orange, teal or a color code you type in this patch's options, or for the color of the phone's wallpaper theme on Android 12 and up. Warnings stay red, and so can…
Advanced downloads

Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story or a video's cover from the share sheet, and pick videos on…
Allow Duet and Stitch

Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Share sheet.
Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.
Always show publish date

Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, or dates on profile grids. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Interface.
Always upload in HD

Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
AMOLED dark theme

Makes TikTok's dark mode backgrounds pure black, or a dark color you pick in this patch's options. Black lets OLED screens switch those pixels off. Light mode doesn't change. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it…
App lock

Asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN before TikTok opens, and again when you come back after a time you pick, so nobody else can open it on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Automatic video advance
Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on TikTok's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Block author button

Adds buttons on videos to block the creator, hide them only on your phone, or block the sound, so you can get rid of what you don't want in one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Block contact list access
Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Block installed app scanning

Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Block P2P video relay

Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.
Block popups

Lets you stop TikTok's popups, like friend suggestions and offers. Each one joins a checklist after it first appears, and once ticked it won't come back. Sign-in, age and verification screens are never blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in Me…
Block suggested video notifications

Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Interface.
Camera and microphone indicator
Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Change app name
Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.
Comment publish diagnostics

Adds a note to Metra's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Comment send fix
Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Comment sort controls

Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.
Comment tools

Hides comments with words you pick or from accounts you pick, and adds a search box for a video's comments. It can also make links tappable and show poll results before you vote. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and tran…
Confirm feed interactions
Asks for a second tap before Follow, a like, or a quick repost goes through, so a stray tap doesn't count. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Copy bio and IDs
Lets you long-press a bio to copy it, and adds share sheet buttons that copy a username, user ID or video ID. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.
Copy comments without username
When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Comments and translation.
Custom launcher icon

Gives TikTok's home screen icon a themed version that takes your wallpaper's color on Android 13 and up. The options can also make it black, plain or your own picture. Only patching again without it puts the old icon back.
Custom offline videos limit

Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Downloads.
Device privacy guard

Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Metra settings > App b…
Diagnostic tools
Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Diagnostics.
Disable login requirement
Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Disable screen capture detection
Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Disable telemetry

Stops TikTok sending usage statistics and crash reports to TikTok and the tracking services it uses, so less of what you do in the app leaves your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Disable the long press quick share
Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Disable the long press repost
Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Double-tap controls

Lets a double tap on a video do nothing, open its comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, speed the video up, or set a sleep timer instead of liking it, so you don't like videos by accident. Starts off. Pick an acti…
Downloads

Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Downloads.
Drop the animated image cache

Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Enable voice comments

Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments a…
Expand activity list
Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Feature Gate Lab

Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Diagnostics.
Feature Gate Recorder
Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in Metra settings > Diagnostics.
Feed filter

Hides ads in the feed, and lets you hide other things you don't want to see, like LIVEs, Shop posts, AI videos or videos with words, creators or sounds you pick. Hiding ads is on by default. Everything else starts off in Metra settings > F…
Feed tab navigation

Lets you hide feed and bottom tabs you don't use, rename the bottom tabs, choose the tab TikTok opens on and stop For You reloading when you tap Home. Starts off, except holding Home to open Metra settings. Find it in Metra settings > Feed…
Feed text sizes
Lets you make video descriptions, creator names and post dates bigger or smaller, so they're easier to read. Starts off. Pick a size in Metra settings > Interface.
Fit the video to the screen

Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Fix Google login
Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Foldable split comment view
On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Follow diagnostics

Tells you when TikTok quietly turned down a follow, and why, since the app shows it as if it worked. With diagnostic logging on, the details go in the report too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Force show Auto scroll
Makes TikTok's Auto scroll action available without starting it automatically. Control it in Metra settings > App behavior.
Ghost mode

Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Hide already seen videos
Remembers the videos you've watched and hides them when the feed sends them again, so you only see new ones. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Feed controls.
Hide CAPTCHA popups

Skips the puzzle TikTok shows while you're just browsing. A puzzle right after you like, follow, comment or repost still shows, and so do sign-in, SMS and two-step checks. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface, then restart…
Hide comment popup ads
Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.
Hide comment typing suggestions

Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.
Hide feed follow button
Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Hide feed LIVE button
Removes the LIVE button and the side menu button from the top left of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Each has its own switch, and both start off. Turn them on in Metra settings > Interface.
Hide feed save button
Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Hide feed search button
Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Hide floating promotions

Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface, and App behavior for the rewards button.
Hide inbox items

Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Tur…
Hide inbox stories
Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Hide Play Store update offer

Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.
Hide profile shortcuts

Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.
Hide search suggestions
Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Hide suggested accounts

Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts on, retaining Metra's existing default. Control it in Metra settings > Interf…
Hide the launcher shortcuts
Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Hide the risk control CAPTCHA

Lets Hide CAPTCHA popups also skip the puzzle TikTok's account safety check raises while you're just browsing. SMS and two-step checks always show. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.
Hide video overlays

Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. It can also make the music disc spin again or keep it still. Each has its own switch. Sta…
Hold-and-slide 2x lock
Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
In-app browser privacy guard

Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Keep a streak going
Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Keep playing in the background

Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then…
Keep pulled sounds
Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Keep the app language

Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Tur…
Keep the Favorites tab

Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default.…
Keep the screen's refresh rate
Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Lift text length limits
Lets you write longer comments, repost notes and bios than the app normally allows. TikTok can still refuse one that's too long. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.
Limit background traffic

Lets you stop TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
LIVE controls

Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restar…
Location access governor
Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Long-press controls

Lets a long press on a video like it, open the comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, or set a sleep timer, and can give a creator's videos For You's full long-press menu. Starts off. Pick an action in Metra settin…
Look like the store app

Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Metra settings > App beh…
Mute feed videos
Mutes feed videos without changing your phone's volume, so music from another app keeps playing. You can also add a mute button on videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Network proxy

Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do Metra's own saves and short-link lookups. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Re…
Network request report
Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.
Not interested button
Adds a button on videos that tells TikTok you're not interested in one tap, so it can show you fewer like it. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Notification controls
Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Open external links directly
Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.
Picture-in-picture
Keeps the video playing in a small window when you leave TikTok, so you can keep watching while you use other apps. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Play SDR instead of HDR
Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Playback quality
Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Metra settings > App behavior.
Playback speed

Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.
Prefer H.264 playback

Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Profile background

Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Tur…
Region spoof

Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings…
Remember clear display

Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video. It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in Metra settings > Interface. When clear display ends, the F…
Remove avatar rings
Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Remove card scanner assets

Removes TikTok's bundled payment card scanner files. Keeps the content credential and runtime libraries loaded by other features, including photo comments. Card scanning may stop working. Patch again without this to restore the removed fil…
Remove creation tools

Removes the bundled face-detection model and effect-creation component. Keeps the shared photo and video editor needed by comment pictures. Face effects and effect creation may stop working. Patch again without this to restore the removed…
Remove LIVE extras

Removes the files for LIVE co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, matches, games and gift effects, so the app gets about 3 MB smaller. The catch: in LIVEs, battle scores and guest names can go missing, and joining someone's LIVE by voice o…
Remove unused language packs

Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.
Repost diagnostics
With diagnostic logging on, notes when you repost a video and what TikTok answered, to help track down reposts that don't stick. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Resource and battery governor

Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Resume videos after scrolling
When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.
Run beside the store app

Lets a renamed copy of TikTok, made with Morphe's Clone app patch, sign in while the regular TikTok stays installed. Pick it together with Clone app. Google and Facebook sign-in won't work in the copy, so use email or phone.
Sanitize sharing links
Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.
Settings

Adds the Metra settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Metra's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no swit…
Share sheet tools

Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, add apps you do use, and copy a video's link with one press on Share. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Share sheet.
Show author region
Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Show commenter handle and region

Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Metra settings > Com…
Show engagement rate
Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Show exact counts
Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Show follow status

Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior. Optional local counts and appearance controls apply to your own profi…
Show LIVE search
Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Show the progress bar

Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger ha…
Show the progress bar thumbnail
Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.
SIM spoof

Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Region spoof.
Skip content warnings
Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
Skip first-launch setup

Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Metra settin…
Skip passkey sign-in

Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone…
Skip the splash ad
Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Skip update checks

Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Stay on the video in full screen
When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Stop on-device AI profiling

Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Stop recording watch history

Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Stop saving search history

Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Stop search autoplay
Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Stop video looping
Stops a video at its end instead of playing it again. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Story controls
Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Subtitle tools

Lets you make captions bigger, change their background and keep them in clear display, and save subtitle files with downloaded videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface, and Downloads for subtitle files.
Swipe-left controls
Lets a left swipe on a video open its comments or do nothing, instead of opening the creator's profile. Starts off. Pick an action in Metra settings > Interface.
Translate comments

Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic transla…
Trust user certificates

Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.
Turn off haptics
Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Turn off screen transitions
Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Use non-personalized search
Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
Use system font

Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.

Asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN before TikTok opens, and again when you come back after a time you pick, so nobody else can open it on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
Automatic video advance
Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on TikTok's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
Block author button

Adds buttons on videos to block the creator, hide them only on your phone, or block the sound, so you can get rid of what you don't want in one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
Block contact list access
Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
Block installed app scanning
Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
Block P2P video relay

Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.
Block popups

Lets you stop TikTok's popups, like friend suggestions and offers. Each one joins a checklist after it first appears, and once ticked it won't come back. Sign-in, age and verification screens are never blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in Hu…
Block suggested video notifications

Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
Camera and microphone indicator
Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
Change app name
Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.
Comment publish diagnostics

Adds a note to Hushfeed's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Comment send fix
Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Comment sort controls

Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
Comment tools

Hides comments with words you pick or from accounts you pick, and adds a search box for a video's comments. It can also make links tappable and show poll results before you vote. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
Confirm feed interactions
Asks for a second tap before Follow, a like, or a quick repost goes through, so a stray tap doesn't count. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
Copy bio and IDs
Lets you long-press a bio to copy it, and adds share sheet buttons that copy a username, user ID or video ID. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.
Copy comments without username
When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
Custom launcher icon

Gives TikTok's home screen icon a themed version that takes your wallpaper's color on Android 13 and up. The options can also make it black, plain or your own picture. Only patching again without it puts the old icon back.
Custom offline videos limit

Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.
Device privacy guard

Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Hushfeed settings > Pr…
Diagnostic tools
Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.
Disable login requirement
Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Disable screen capture detection
Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Disable telemetry

Stops TikTok sending usage statistics and crash reports to TikTok and the tracking services it uses, so less of what you do in the app leaves your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
Disable the long press quick share
Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
Disable the long press repost
Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
Double-tap controls

Lets a double tap on a video do nothing, open its comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, speed the video up, or set a sleep timer instead of liking it, so you don't like videos by accident. Each corner of the video…
Downloads

Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.
Drop the animated image cache

Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
Enable voice comments

Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comment…
Expand activity list
Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
Feature Gate Lab

Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.
Feature Gate Recorder
Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.
Feed filter

Hides ads in the feed, and lets you hide other things you don't want to see, like LIVEs, Shop posts, AI videos or videos with words, creators or sounds you pick. Hiding ads is on by default. Everything else starts off in Hushfeed settings…
Feed tab navigation

Lets you hide feed and bottom tabs you don't use, rename the bottom tabs, choose the tab TikTok opens on, stop For You reloading when you tap Home and hold Profile to open your Watch history. Starts off, except holding Home to open Hushfee…
Feed text sizes
Lets you make video descriptions, creator names and post dates bigger or smaller, so they're easier to read. Starts off. Pick a size in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
Fit the video to the screen

Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen, and fits photo slideshows whole on squarer screens. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on…
Fix Google login
Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Foldable split comment view
On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
Follow diagnostics

Tells you when TikTok quietly turned down a follow, and why, since the app shows it as if it worked. With diagnostic logging on, the details go in the report too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Ghost mode

Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
Hide already seen videos
Remembers the videos you've watched and hides them when the feed sends them again, so you only see new ones. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.
Hide CAPTCHA popups

Skips the puzzle TikTok shows while you're just browsing. A puzzle right after you like, follow, comment or repost still shows, and so do sign-in, SMS and two-step checks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, then res…
Hide comment popup ads
Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
Hide comment typing suggestions
Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
Hide feed follow button
Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
Hide feed LIVE button

Removes the LIVE button and the side menu button from the top left of the feed, for a cleaner screen, and can stop a right swipe on For You from opening the side menu. Each has its own switch, and all start off. Turn them on in Hushfeed se…
Hide feed save button
Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
Hide feed search button
Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
Hide floating promotions

Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.
Hide inbox items

Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Tur…
Hide inbox stories
Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
Hide Play Store update offer

Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.
Hide profile shortcuts

Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble, and Balance and the TikTok Minis icons in your profile's menu. It can also turn Thoughts on for accounts…
Hide search suggestions
Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
Hide suggested accounts

Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
Hide the launcher shortcuts
Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
Hide the risk control CAPTCHA

Lets Hide CAPTCHA popups also skip the puzzle TikTok's account safety check raises while you're just browsing. SMS and two-step checks always show. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.
Hide video overlays

Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. It can also make the music disc spin again or keep it still. Each has its own switch. Sta…
Hold-and-slide 2x lock
Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
In-app browser privacy guard

Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
Keep a streak going
Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
Keep playing in the background

Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback, then r…
Keep pulled sounds
Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
Keep the app language

Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Tur…
Keep the Favorites tab

Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default.…
Keep the screen's brightness in the camera
Stops TikTok from turning your screen brighter while you film, edit or post a video. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
Keep the screen's refresh rate
Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
Lift text length limits
Lets you write longer comments, repost notes and bios than the app normally allows. TikTok can still refuse one that's too long. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
Limit background traffic
Lets you stop TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
LIVE controls

Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restar…
Load all saved stickers
Loads every sticker you saved when you open the sticker panel. PineDrama otherwise shows only the first 100 and never loads the rest. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Location access governor
Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
Long-press controls

Lets a long press on a video like it, open the comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, or set a sleep timer, and can give a creator's videos For You's full long-press menu. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed set…
Look like the store app

Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.
Mute feed videos
Mutes feed videos without changing your phone's volume, so music from another app keeps playing. You can also add a mute button on videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
Network proxy

Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do Hushfeed's own saves and short-link lookups. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed setting…
Network request report
Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.
Not interested button
Adds a button on videos that tells TikTok you're not interested in one tap, so it can show you fewer like it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
Notification controls
Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
Open external links directly
Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
Open the comments at full height
Opens the comment sheet at the full height of the screen instead of part way up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
Picture-in-picture
Keeps the video playing in a small window when you leave TikTok, so you can keep watching while you use other apps. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
Play SDR instead of HDR
Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
Playback quality
Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
Playback speed

Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
Prefer H.264 playback

Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
Profile background

Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Tur…
Region spoof

Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed setti…
Remember clear display

Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video (`Keep Clear display across videos` turns that part off). It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in H…
Remove avatar rings

Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. It can also open a LIVE creator's Story from their profile picture or their chat in the Inbox. Starts off. Turn it on i…
Remove content credential and card scanner assets

Removes TikTok's payment card scanner and content credential files, saving about 11 MB of storage. Anything in TikTok that needs them may stop working. Only patching again without it brings them back.
Remove creation tools

Removes TikTok's camera, editing and effects files, saving about 38 MB of storage. The catch: the Create tab and every recording, editing and effects tool stop working, and opening one, like effect search, can close TikTok. Leave it out if…
Remove LIVE extras

Removes the files for LIVE co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, matches, games and gift effects, so the app gets about 3 MB smaller. The catch: in LIVEs, battle scores and guest names can go missing, and joining someone's LIVE by voice o…
Remove unused language packs

Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.
Remove voice tools

Removes TikTok's speech recognition files, saving about 16 MB of storage. The catch: voice search, naming a song by listening, talking to TikTok's AI assistant and TikTok's music check on videos you post all stop working. Only patching aga…
Report a newer phone to effects
Tells TikTok's effects server you have a newer phone, so effects it turns down on older phones get another chance. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
Repost diagnostics
With diagnostic logging on, notes when you repost a video and what TikTok answered, to help track down reposts that don't stick. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Resource and battery governor

Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
Resume videos after scrolling
When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
Run beside the store app

Lets a renamed copy of TikTok, made with Morphe's Clone app patch, sign in while the regular TikTok stays installed. Pick it together with Clone app. Google and Facebook sign-in won't work in the copy, so use email or phone.
Sanitize sharing links
Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
Settings

Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with n…
Share sheet tools

Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, add apps you do use, and copy a video's link with one press on Share. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.
Show author region
Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
Show commenter handle and region

Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings >…
Show engagement rate
Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
Show exact counts
Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
Show follow status

Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App. Optional local counts and appearance controls apply to your own profile.
Show LIVE search
Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
Show the progress bar

Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger han…
Show the progress bar thumbnail
Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
SIM spoof

Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.
Skip content warnings
Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
Skip first-launch setup

Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Hushfeed set…
Skip passkey sign-in

Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone…
Skip the splash ad
Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
Skip update checks

Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
Stay on the video in full screen
When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
Stop on-device AI profiling

Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
Stop recording watch history

Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
Stop saving search history
Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
Stop search autoplay
Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
Stop video looping
Stops a video at its end instead of playing it again. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
Story controls
Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
Subtitle tools

Lets you make captions bigger, change their background and keep them in clear display, bring back TikTok's captions switch where it's missing, and save subtitle files with downloaded videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Fe…
Swipe-left controls
Lets a left swipe on a video open its comments or do nothing, instead of opening the creator's profile. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
Translate comments

Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should l…
Trust user certificates

Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.
Turn off haptics
Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
Turn off screen transitions
Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
Use non-personalized search
Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
Use system font

Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patch_list: Allow Screenshots
Removes screenshot and screen recording blocking.
Always Show Publish Date
Shows the upload date on all videos.
Auto-Pause First Video
Pauses the first video on launch so it plays without lag.
Battery & Resource Saver
Stops 3D ad sensors and aggressive video preloading to save battery and data.
Block P2P Video Relay
Stops your device from uploading videos to other users.
Block Popups & Prompts
Blocks popups, nags and promo dialogs across the app.
Block Trackers
Neutralizes ByteDance AppLog tracking, crash monitors, and analytics.
Block Trackers (Setup)
Removes tracking permissions and disables telemetry components.
Bypass Mandatory Login
Lets you browse videos and feeds without creating an account or logging in.
Camera & Microphone Indicator
Shows a corner mark while TikTok holds camera/mic open.
Clean Share Links
Removes tracking parameters from shared links.
Comment Customizer
Takes control of comments: sort, copy, translate and hide clutter.
Custom Share Sheet
Lets you hide share menu entries you do not use.
Customize Search
Customizes search suggestions, live recommendations, and autoplay.
Declutter Direct Messages
Cleans up chat and DM screens by hiding extra buttons.
Declutter Navigation Bar
Removes extra tabs and buttons from navigation bars.
Declutter Video Interface
Cleans up the buttons and overlays on top of videos.
Device Privacy Guard
Blocks access to your contacts, location, apps and sensors.
Disable History Recording
Prevents TikTok from recording your watch history and search queries.
Disable Live Gift Effects
Disables 3D gift animations in live streams to prevent frame drops.
Disable On-Device AI
Turns off on-device AI, the chatbot and AI search.
Disable Push Notifications
Stops background push notifications.
Disable QUIC
Loads videos, uploads, and live connections over standard HTTPS instead of QUIC.
Download Without Watermark
Unlocks downloading and saves videos without watermarks.
Enable Profile Banner
Unlocks the profile banner and its editing tools.
Feed Ads & Content Filter
Filters ads, shopping tags, live cards, and clutter from your feed.
Force Auto-Scroll
Enables native auto-scrolling to the next video.
Friends & Suggestions Filter
Keeps the Friends feed strictly mutual and hides suggested accounts across the app.
Hide Inbox Promos & Alerts
Hides promo banners, streak cards and suggestions in your inbox.
Hide Inbox Story Tray

patch_list: Animated profile covers
Plays the short animation TikTok used to show in each video's preview on a profile grid. It can be turned off in the Pixkk Patches settings.
Centered comment menu
Shows the menu a press and hold on a comment opens as a window in the middle of the screen, as it used to be, instead of a sheet along the bottom.
Comment menu rows

Lets you pick which rows the menu a press and hold on a comment opens shows. The rows are read from the menu itself as it opens, so nothing is fixed in the patch: the list in the Pixkk Patches settings holds every row the menu has shown.
Discover tab
Puts the Discover tab (the compass) in the bottom bar where Friends is. It can be turned off in the Pixkk Patches settings.
Don't open comments on icon swipe

Lets a swipe that starts on one of the buttons down the right of a video (avatar, like, comments, save, share) scroll to the next video, instead of pressing the button when the finger comes up. It can be turned off in the Pixkk Patches set…
Expand description in place
Makes See more unfold the description right where it is, the way TikTok used to, instead of opening the full text in a new screen. Starts off. Turn it on in the Pixkk Patches settings.
Old-style counts
Writes long like, comment and other counts as 12.3K and 1.2M in every language, not with the language's own word for thousand. It can be turned off in the Pixkk Patches settings.
Old-style seeking

Dragging along the progress bar in the feed puts the video where your finger is on the bar, as TikTok used to, instead of moving it by how far the finger travels. It can be turned off in the Pixkk Patches settings.
pixkk settings row
Turns the What's New row in Settings and privacy into the Pixkk Patches settings.

Lets you widen or close up the gap between the buttons down the right of a video: avatar, like, comments, save and share. The gap is set in the Pixkk Patches settings, and 0 leaves TikTok's own spacing.
Scroll sound name
